consumer: The crafting menu's recipe-availability check (the engine's can_craft/recipe-requirement evaluation) asking 'can the player make this recipe here and now?'
scope: The full crafting inventory the recipe predicate sees: items on person PLUS items in reach of the crafting location (adjacent tiles, nearby containers/vehicles), not just avatar.carried_items[].
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which dumps only the avatar's wielded/worn/inventory items as raw item records and never consults the recipe-craftability predicate or nearby reachable items.
divergence: A recipe whose required component sits in an adjacent crate or on the ground within crafting reach but not on the player: the engine's recipe predicate reports it craftable (counts nearby reachable items), but carried_items[] omits the component, so re-deriving craftability from the dump wrongly reports 'cannot craft'.
